_floor: Which rule decides a pool's floor price. Swap `strategy` freely; see lib/floor.mjs for the list. Nothing else in the code changes.
_exchange: Approximate worth of one unit in exalted, used ONLY to compare a modifier against its baseline and to order a list. No stored price is ever converted: a listing keeps the amount and currency GGG sent, and the floor still comes from the rank GGG's own price ordering gave it. These numbers are a standing guess, they drift through a league, and every published row that leans on one says so with assumedRate.
_quick: `node cli.mjs update --quick` re-asks only the modifiers the LAST pass already measured at minRatio or better, plus every baseline. It cannot discover a modifier that has become valuable since, so it is a refresh and never a replacement for a full pass. 1.5 rather than the 2.1 high band on purpose: the modifiers worth watching are the ones near the line, not the ones already over it.
_testSet: One tablet type and ten modifiers, so the walk can be iterated without spending a day's rate allowance. Run with `--test-set`. High-value, mid and filler modifiers are all present on purpose: a walk that cannot separate them is not working.

affixes.note: of the Invasion — extra rare monsters on stabilise; the guide calls this the Breach-specific premium
Monster Effectiveness — premium multiplier on any tablet
increased Rarity of Items found — premium multiplier
increased number of Rare Monsters — good multiplier

_walk: minLift is a ratio against the blank-tablet floor. Note the baseline is the cheapest tablet of ANY kind, while each modifier cell is sampled at the cheapest tablet CARRYING that modifier — constraining a search at all raises its floor, so a low threshold admits modifiers that are not really worth anything.
